jobs.title: Manager, TV Audio Infrastructure
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**

WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. WWE is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO). Additional information on WWE can be found at wwe.com and corporate.wwe.com. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Manager of Broadcast TV Audio Infrastructure assists senior management with responsibilities for the design, operation, maintenance, and strategic development of audio systems while supporting live and recorded television production. This role supports a team of broadcast audio technicians, ensuring reliable, high-quality audio across studios, control rooms, remote productions, and transmission facilities. The manager works closely with production, engineering, IT, and operations teams to support current workflows while planning future technology upgrades.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Audio Infrastructure Management**

* Oversee the operation and maintenance of broadcast audio systems, including intercoms (wired/wireless), audio-over-IP networks, RFOF systems, RF Microphones and IEM monitoring systems.
* Develop and maintain preventative maintenance schedules and system documentation.
* Collaborate with external vendors to prioritize, schedule, and expedite repairs, ensuring maximum system reliability and uptime.

### **Technical Leadership**

* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex audio and broadcast infrastructure issues.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend upgrades to improve efficiency, scalability, and audio quality.
* Collaborate with IT teams on networked audio systems.

### **Project Management**

* Plan and execute capital projects, upgrades, technical work books, equipment refreshes, and system integrations.
* Coordinate installation, testing, commissioning, and acceptance of new systems.
* Demoing new audio technologies.

### **Team Leadership**

* Collaborate with upper management to supervise, mentor, and develop broadcast audio engineers and technical staff.
* Coordinate staffing and technical support coverage for live events and special productions.

### 

### **Operational Support**

* Support live broadcast, entertainment, and special event productions.
* Ensure compliance with FCC regulations, company standards, and industry best practices.
* Participate in on-call escalation support for critical broadcast operations.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Engineering, Audio Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of experience in broadcast engineering, professional audio, or television infrastructure environments.
* Extensive knowledge of broadcast audio systems, signal routing, and transmission workflows.
* Understanding Dante platforms.
* Strong understanding of television production environments and live broadcast operations.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience supporting large-scale network television operations.
* Familiarity with broadcast intercom systems.
* Professional certifications in broadcast engineering.
* Experience with wireless communications, and Audio production technologies.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Broadcast systems infrastructure
* Audio engineering expertise
* Project planning and execution
* Problem-solving under pressure
* This role combines broadcast audio engineering expertise with operational leadership to ensure reliable, high-quality audio delivery across all television platforms.

Per local requirements and in the interest of transparency, the hourly rate shown below reflects the prevalent current hiring range for this position. Hiring pay rates are based on a number of factors, including location and may vary depending on job-related qualifications, knowledge, skills and experience. The company strives to provide locally competitive rewards packages, which include base rate along with, as applicable, short- and long-term incentives, growth and developmental opportunities, and robust benefits, such as health care, retirement, vacation and other paid time off, and additional offerings.

Hiring Rate Minimum:

$101,250 annually (minimum will not fall below the applicable State/local minimum salary thresholds)

Hiring Rate Maximum:

$135,000 annually

WWE is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding non-discrimination in employment.
